review_kind: AI-reviewed translation (Claude, direct exact-source translation and technical self-review); no native-speaker signoff
review: N673 True 3D speed follow-up: Render backend list, Render scale slider, mask surface Finish list, 3D magnifier cube and the render detail line. Finish names inside the Finish tooltip match the translated option names; Auto matches the existing translation; OpenGL is identity text.

records.key: A cube that shows the volume inside it magnified and dims everything outside it. It follows the pointer; Shift+wheel changes its size and Ctrl+wheel its zoom. M turns it on and off.
records.source: A cube that shows the volume inside it magnified and dims everything outside it. It follows the pointer; Shift+wheel changes its size and Ctrl+wheel its zoom. M turns it on and off.
records.translation: Teningur sem sýnir rúmmálið innan í sér stækkað og deyfir allt utan hans. Hann fylgir bendlinum; Shift+hjól breytir stærð hans og Ctrl+hjól aðdrætti hans. M kveikir og slekkur á honum.

records.key: What draws the 3D view. Auto uses the graphics card (OpenGL) when it works and the CPU otherwise.
records.source: What draws the 3D view. Auto uses the graphics card (OpenGL) when it works and the CPU otherwise.
records.translation: Það sem teiknar þrívíddarsýnina. Sjálfvirkt notar skjákortið (OpenGL) þegar það virkar og annars CPU-örgjörvann.

records.key: How much of the full resolution the 3D view is drawn at, along each axis. Turning the view draws coarser and sharpens to this when it stops.
records.source: How much of the full resolution the 3D view is drawn at, along each axis. Turning the view draws coarser and sharpens to this when it stops.
records.translation: Hve stór hluti fullrar upplausnar er notaður til að teikna þrívíddarsýnina, eftir hverjum ás. Á meðan sýninni er snúið er teiknað grófar og skerpt upp í þetta gildi þegar hún stöðvast.

records.key: GPU rendering is unavailable ({reason}); drawing on the CPU.
records.source: GPU rendering is unavailable ({reason}); drawing on the CPU.
records.translation: GPU-myndgerð er ekki tiltæk ({reason}); teiknað á CPU.

records.key: How the mask surfaces catch the light: Matte is dull, Satin has a soft sheen, Glossy a sharp white highlight and Metallic a highlight in the object's own colour.
records.source: How the mask surfaces catch the light: Matte is dull, Satin has a soft sheen, Glossy a sharp white highlight and Metallic a highlight in the object's own colour.
records.translation: Hvernig yfirborð grímanna grípur ljósið: Matt er dauft, Satín hefur mjúkan gljáa, Gljáandi skarpan hvítan glampa og Málmkennt glampa í eigin lit hlutarins.
